source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of accessing list items (PDF 51).

blocks.text: List ke items un ke index (number) se nikale jate hain, aur index 0 se shuru hota hai. Misaal: fruits list ka doosra item print karein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"fruits = ["Mango", "Apple", "Banana"]": teen phalon ki list; un ke index 0, 1 aur 2 hain.
"print(fruits [1])": index 1 wala item, yani doosra item, print hota hai (ginti 0 se shuru hoti hai). fruits aur [1] ke beech space ka koi asar nahi.
"# Output: Apple": comment hai jo jawab batata hai; yeh chalta nahi.
Output: Apple
Khud try karein: fruits [1] ko fruits [2] kar ke Run karein: ab Banana aayega.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab list ko tirchhi (curly) quotes, ek faltu quote aur bina band bracket ke chhapti hai (”Apple”, “” Banana”); aise SyntaxError aata hai. Sahi: fruits = ["Mango", "Apple", "Banana"].
index badal kar (maslan 0, 2 ya -1) Run karein aur dekhein list ka kaunsa item nikalta hai. 3 dene par IndexError aata hai kyun ke teen items ke index 0, 1, 2 hain.

fruits = ["Mango", "Apple", "Banana"]
index = 1
print("Index", index, "par:", fruits[index])
print("Kul items:", len(fruits))

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"fruits = ["Mango", "Apple", "Banana"]": teen items ki list (index 0, 1, 2).
"index = 1": is variable mein woh index rakha hai jis ka item chahiye.
"print("Index", index, "par:", fruits[index])": fruits[1] yani "Apple" nikal kar sentence ki shakal mein print hota hai.
"print("Kul items:", len(fruits))": len() list ke items ginta hai: 3.
Output: pehli line "Index 1 par: Apple", doosri "Kul items: 3".
Khud try karein: index = 2 kar ke Run karein: "Index 2 par: Banana" aayega; index = 3 par IndexError aayega kyunke index 3 maujood hi nahi.

items: Index 0 se shuru: pehla item fruits[0], doosra fruits[1].
